تعتقلي (form VIII)
# تَعْتَقِلِي (taʕtaqilī) /taʕ.ta.qi.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# تُعْتَقَلِي (tuʕtaqalī) /tuʕ.ta.qa.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
